name: AI-assisted borescope inspection (Aiir Innovations)
summary: AI software that analyzes borescope video for faster, more repeatable engine inspections; Pratt & Whitney acquired developer Aiir Innovations in July 2026.
paragraphs: AI software that analyzes borescope video for faster, more repeatable engine inspections; Pratt & Whitney acquired developer Aiir Innovations in July 2026.
whyItMatters: Pratt & Whitney says it is already rolled out to commercial customers and MRO providers and in use on V2500 inspections.
